home.brand.emptyBody: Add your name, website, logo and official profiles once. Organization, website, article and event schemas will reuse them automatically.

templates.title: Choose a schema template
templates.subtitle: Every template includes field guidance, examples and live checks. Not sure? Start with Organization / brand.
templates.limit: Up to {max} documents can be stored locally. Export or delete some before adding more.
editor.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it lives in another browser.
editor.fieldsCleared: Removed fields that do not apply to the new type
field.complex: This field uses an advanced structure (such as an array or nested object). To avoid losing data, edit it in JSON-LD mode.
json.label: JSON-LD source
json.hint: Edit directly; valid content is applied as you type. Unknown properties are preserved. Size limit: 100 KiB.
json.notObject: The top level must be a JSON object, e.g. { "@type": "Organization" }.
json.pending: Not applied because of errors; the form still shows the last valid content.
json.code.forbidden_key: contains a forbidden property name (__proto__, constructor or prototype)
preview.ai.title: How AI might describe you
preview.ai.note: Illustrative text composed from your structured data — not output from any AI system.
preview.ai.empty: Add a name and basic details to see what machines can read about you.
preview.search.title: Search result mock-up
preview.search.note: Illustration only. Search engines decide the actual display; rich results are not guaranteed.
preview.entity.title: Entity card
audit.title: Completeness
audit.unknown: {count} fields use advanced structures and are not scored.
audit.unknown.one: {count} field uses an advanced structure and is not scored.
audit.disclaimer: Completeness follows this tool’s rules and is advisory only. It does not guarantee rankings, rich results or AI citations.
audit.validate: Before publishing, verify with official tools:
code.title: Add to your website
code.step2: Paste it into the page’s <head> (or your CMS “custom code” field).
code.step3: After publishing, confirm with the Google Rich Results Test.
code.cdnTitle: Tired of editing site code for every change?
code.cdnBody: The TrueLink platform offers hosted schema deployment: update once and your site stays in sync.
status.title: Document status
status.visibilityValue: Private · nothing is ever published automatically
delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: This deletes the document from this browser only (there is no cloud copy). You can undo right after deleting.
library.title: My schemas
library.subtitle: {count}/{max} documents · stored only in this browser
library.emptyBody: Start from a template, or import JSON-LD already on your site.
library.nearLimit: {count}/{max} local documents — almost full. Managing more sites and documents? The TrueLink platform offers online schema management.
transfer.title: Import & export
transfer.subtitle: Bring in structured data from your site, or take your work with you.
transfer.import.title: Import JSON-LD
transfer.import.body: Paste JSON-LD, a full page’s HTML source or data from the TrueLink web tool, or choose a .json / .html file. You preview everything first; existing documents are never overwritten.
transfer.import.label: Content to import
transfer.import.htmlNone: This HTML has no application/ld+json blocks.
transfer.export.title: Combined export
transfer.export.body: Merge every document into one @graph snippet — handy for a shared <head>.
transfer.backup.title: Backup & restore
transfer.backup.body: Download all documents and your brand profile as a backup file. Back up before switching computers, clearing browser data or uninstalling the app.
transfer.backup.invalid: This is not a valid Schema Studio backup file.
transfer.backup.preview: The backup contains {count} documents{brand}. Documents are added as copies; nothing is overwritten.
transfer.backup.preview.one: The backup contains {count} document{brand}. It is added as a copy; nothing is overwritten.
transfer.backup.replaceBrand: Also replace my current brand profile with the backup’s
transfer.backup.skipped: ({count} unreadable or over the limit were skipped)
transfer.backup.skipped.one: ({count} unreadable or over the limit was skipped)
brand.title: Brand profile
brand.subtitle: Set it up once and every schema fills itself in. A complete, consistent brand entity helps search engines and AI confirm who you are.
brand.step.basics.desc: Name, website and logo are where recognition starts.
brand.step.contact.desc: A reachable entity with an address is easier to confirm as real.
brand.step.profiles.desc: Every official page you run is one more piece of evidence to cross-check.
brand.step.authority.desc: Expertise, founding date and founders support E-E-A-T expertise and trust.
brand.profiles.invalid: Enter a full URL starting with https://.
brand.doneBody: Create these schemas in one click — your brand details fill in automatically:
brand.privacy: Your brand profile stays in this browser and is never uploaded.
brand.promo.title: Next: help AI verify your brand
brand.promo.body: TrueLink helps deploy and maintain your schema, and builds your identity and official profiles into trust evidence AI can verify.
account.title: Account & sync
account.subtitle: Every editing feature is free and local. Join TrueLink when you need deployment, maintenance and trust verification.
account.status.title: Current status
account.status.local: Local mode: all data stays in this browser
account.status.linking: TrueLink account linking: planned, not yet available
account.hero.title: Join TrueLink so AI can find, verify and cite your brand
account.hero.body: Schema Studio organizes your brand data. The TrueLink platform helps you deploy and maintain it, and build it into trust evidence AI can verify.
account.benefit.deploy.title: Hosted schema deployment
account.benefit.deploy.body: Deploy structured data through the TrueLink platform’s CDN, so updates don’t require editing your site code each time.
account.benefit.geo.title: GEO & E-E-A-T strategy
account.benefit.geo.body: Go beyond rankings to generative engines: strengthen entity authority so AI recognizes your expertise.
account.benefit.trust.title: A verifiable trust network
account.benefit.trust.body: Connect brand identity, content and official profiles into evidence that helps AI engines confirm who you are.
account.benefit.sync.title: Cloud draft sync (planned)
account.benefit.sync.body: In the future, selected local drafts can sync to your TrueLink account after you explicitly agree. Signing in never uploads anything automatically.
account.benefit.syncLive.title: Cloud drafts
account.benefit.syncLive.body: Keep selected documents in your TrueLink account and continue on other devices. Nothing uploads until you press "Upload".
account.status.cloudOutdated: TrueLink account: reload to use the latest version
cloud.title: TrueLink cloud drafts
cloud.unavailable: TrueLink cannot be reached right now. Your documents are still safe on this device.
cloud.signedOut: Sign in to your TrueLink account to keep selected documents as cloud drafts and continue on other devices.
cloud.rules: Only documents you upload are saved to your account, and nothing becomes public; publishing to your website is a separate step. Linked documents without changes on this device follow newer versions from TrueLink automatically.
cloud.outdated: TrueLink has updated its Schema core. Reload to use the latest version before syncing.
cloud.empty: There are no documents on this device or in the cloud yet.
cloud.done.upload: Uploaded to your TrueLink cloud drafts.
cloud.done.copy: Saved the cloud version as a new document.
cloud.error.conflict: The cloud copy was updated on another device. Choose which version to keep first.
cloud.error.signed-out: Your TrueLink session ended. Please sign in again.
cloud.error.quota: You have reached the cloud draft limit.
cloud.error.invalid: This document does not meet the requirements for uploading or publishing.
cloud.error.localLimit: This device has reached its document limit. Delete or export some documents first.
cloud.error.generic: TrueLink could not complete this right now. Please try again later.
cloud.confirm.useCloud.title: Use the cloud version?
cloud.confirm.useCloud.body: Your changes to "{name}" on this device will be replaced by the cloud version. To keep both, choose "Keep both" instead.
cloud.confirm.keepLocal.title: Replace the cloud copy?
cloud.confirm.keepLocal.body: The cloud version saved from another device will be replaced by "{name}" from this device.
cloud.confirm.delete.title: Delete the cloud draft?
cloud.confirm.delete.body: Only the cloud draft of "{name}" on TrueLink is deleted. The document on this device is not affected.
cloud.confirm.deleteOnly.body: "{name}" exists only in the cloud. Deleting it cannot be undone.
cloud.publish.title: Publish to TrueLink
cloud.publish.body: Pick a synced Organization, Local business or Person schema (optionally with an FAQ) to publish as your public TrueLink schema. Websites with the TrueLink schema script installed will serve the new version.
cloud.publish.none: You have not published from here yet.
cloud.publish.needMain: Upload an Organization, Local business or Person schema to the cloud before publishing.
cloud.publish.confirmBody: "{name}" becomes your public TrueLink schema, replacing the version published now, and the official score is recalculated. The TrueLink schema script on your website may take a few minutes to update.
account.compare.title: Local free edition vs. TrueLink account
account.compare.offline: Install as an app, work offline
account.leaveNote: Opens the TrueLink site in a new tab. Your drafts stay here — come back any time.
account.privacy.title: Your data, your call
account.privacy.body: Signing up or signing in never uploads your drafts automatically. This tool currently sends no data to any server, and links to TrueLink never carry your schemas or personal details.
settings.title: Settings
settings.install.title: Install the app
settings.install.body: Open it from your desktop or home screen and use it fully offline.
settings.install.ios: On iPhone/iPad: tap Safari’s Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
settings.install.unavailable: This browser does not currently offer installation. Try Chrome, Edge, or Safari’s “Add to Home Screen”.
settings.storage.title: Local storage
settings.storage.body: Documents and your brand profile live in this browser’s localStorage. Clearing browser data deletes them, so download backups regularly.
settings.storage.clearBody: This deletes every schema document and your brand profile from this browser and cannot be undone. Download a backup first.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.body: Schema Studio is an open-source TrueLink tool (MIT license). It uses no tracking or analytics and never sends your data to a server.
settings.feedback.title: Feedback and contributing
settings.feedback.body: Schema Studio is developed in the open. Report problems, suggest templates or help translate on GitHub. Please don’t paste private data into public issues.
storage.quota: Browser storage is full; your latest changes are not saved. Download a backup or delete some documents.
storage.limit: Local data reached the 3 MiB limit; your latest changes are not saved. Download a backup or delete some documents.
storage.documentTooLarge: A document exceeds the 100 KiB limit; your latest changes are not saved.
storage.unavailable: Local storage is unavailable (private mode or blocked). Data disappears when you close the page — remember to export.
storage.recovered: Some local data was unreadable and was skipped. The original text is kept in browser storage, not deleted.
nudge.export.title: Code copied!
nudge.export.body: Want your schema deployed and kept up to date automatically? The TrueLink platform can host your structured data.
